memories.content: Each colleague sees the swap channel and may consider taking the shift based on their own preferences and availability. They have no prior commitment to Karolina regarding this shift.
The ward has a swap channel where nurses can post shift exchange requests. The rota locks on Friday at 15:00. Karolina's post is visible to all colleagues in the channel.
